correctness.rationale: Exact differentiation of the aperiodic base-energy functional gives a zero gradient at the sextic Barker point and the displayed integer Hessian. Exact arithmetic verifies all five unit-modulus sidelobes, reconstructs the Hessian, identifies the two symmetry kernel vectors, and factors the characteristic polynomial with positive transverse roots 1, 5, 9, and 21. The transverse second-derivative test is sufficient for strict local minimality modulo the two exact symmetries. Parseval independently gives the fourth-moment translation.

value.rationale: The length-six generalized Barker sequence is a canonical first missing binary Barker length and a standard polyphase benchmark. The exact transverse spectrum provides a rigorous local stability certificate for the integrated-sidelobe/fourth-moment objective and separates the two forced symmetry zero modes from four genuine stiffness modes. This is structurally useful for perturbation analysis and optimization near the classical Barker orbit, rather than a recomputation of the already tabulated energy value.
